propositions: Plan review has no criterion checking whether a ticket's own acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable, so contradictions surface late during implementation or at the close gate.

A new 1-TURN advisory criterion ac-satisfiability (facet coherence, default 0.95) is added on a generic set-quantification primitive naming three contradiction shapes: universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality.
G3's child-coverage audit cannot fire because the sibling roster carries only ids and titles, so the anti-false-positive rule silences the finding every time.
The sibling roster is fed each child's acceptance-criteria items via evaluate_plan_clarity().ac_items, degrading gracefully to an id/title line when a child has no parseable criteria.

The roster-building expression is duplicated across three non-test callers (pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, eval_solver.py) and is single-sourced into one build_sibling_roster helper to prevent eval/production divergence corrupting dogfooding data.
The roster is moved from per-pairing instructions into the byte-stable system prompt prefix and its token cost is added to the parent_tokens estimate feeding bin-packing and the warm-cache gate.
